decision.summary: The inspection report shows a dog flap and Bedroom 1 sticker marks, but our email of 17 Feb told the landlord there were no issues. I corrected that with the landlord. I asked the tenant about consent for the dog flap, the lock change and a spare key. I set a follow-up for 22 Feb.

answers.question: Where does this case stand right now, and what is outstanding?
answers.answer: The inspection is complete and the report is filed. Outstanding: the tenant's answers on dog flap consent and the lock change, a spare key to the agency, the landlord's decision on the dog flap, and the Bedroom 1 marks to be made good.

answers.question: What is the next action, who is it for, and through which channel?
answers.answer: Emails have been sent to the tenant and to the landlord (existing threads), and a follow-up is set for 22 Feb.

answers.question: Does anything need a human decision, and why?
answers.answer: Not yet. The landlord decides on the dog flap. A human is needed only if the landlord and tenant give conflicting accounts, or the sender's identity cannot be settled.

args.body: Thank you for your email of 18 Feb. First, a correction: our email of 17 Feb said no issues were found. The attached report does in fact note (1) a dog flap installed in the utility room/back door, and (2) sticker-type marks on the Bedroom 1 wall that the tenant is to remove and make good. Sorry for the confusion. On the dog flap: our records show no consent for it, so we are asking the tenant whether permission was given and will tell you the answer. On the spare front door key: our records do not show a lock change. We are asking the tenant who changed it and when, and asking for a spare key to be sent to the agency. We will update you by 22 Feb. Please also confirm the dog flap is not something you have agreed to, and whether you hold any earlier key.

args.body: Hello, thank you for letting us in for the inspection. Two things please. 1) The report notes a dog flap in the back door. Changes like this need the landlord's written consent under the tenancy's alterations and pets clauses. Did you get consent, and if so from whom and when? 2) Has the front door lock been changed, and if so when and by whom? Please send a spare front door key to the agency by 25 Feb so we hold a copy. We are not entering without notice; this is just so the landlord has access in an emergency. Also, the report notes marks on the Bedroom 1 wall by the window, which look like command strip stickers. Please remove them and make good. We will be in touch again by 22 Feb.
